pred_ddx.label: Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) alternative - likely a leiomyoma variant

Leiomyoma: The histopathological findings of smooth muscle staining positive for smooth muscle antigens and negative for C-Kit antigens, along with the absence of significant mitotic activity and tumor necrosis, strongly support a diagnosis of leiomyoma, a benign tumor of smooth muscle origin.
Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) al: Although the absence of C-Kit antigens makes GIST less likely, a variant of leiomyoma could still be considered, given the smooth muscle origin and the clinical presentation of the patient.
